title: AI search visibility across the whole conversation
excerpt: Vouch is a generative engine optimisation tool that shows how AI assistants talk about your brand across a whole buying conversation, and where you drop out.
content_html:
What happens after the prompt.

Vouch is a generative engine optimisation (GEO) tool that shows brands how AI assistants talk about them across a whole buying conversation, and where they drop out. AI search does not end at the first answer: buyers ask five more questions, and that is where your brand wins or disappears.

Invite-only for now. Every invitation starts with a 14-day free trial. Assistants tracked today: Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Perplexity (API answers), Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode and Copilot (Bing AI answer). Threads run on 4 of the 7 (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT and Perplexity (API answers)).

What you see in Vouch

The dashboard leads with the week’s Vouch Rate. Open any Thread to read the conversation question by question and see the stage where your brand dropped out.

See what happens after the prompt

A one-minute tour, with a voice-over and captions.

Read the transcript

Ask ChatGPT for the best running shoes for marathon training, and your brand might make the first answer. But buyers don’t stop at one question. They ask which is lighter. Which lasts longer. Which is better value. And by the third follow-up, your brand is gone.

Here’s the thing. Vouch shows you exactly where that happens. It asks the questions your buyers ask, across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and more, and follows the conversation through every turn.

So you see your Vouch Rate, right next to every competitor, week by week.

You see the exact answer where you dropped out, and why.

And you get clear fixes, plus a report you can share with your team.

So, stop guessing what happens after the prompt. Try Vouch free, at vouchgeo.com.

People don’t ask the AI one question. They have a conversation.

Most tools check whether your brand is mentioned in the first answer. Buyers keep asking: for a shortlist, the downsides, whether to trust you, whether you are worth the price, and which one to buy. You can be named first and still lose the sale four questions later.

How Threads work

A Thread is one buyer’s conversation with an AI assistant, six questions long. Vouch asks your tracked prompt, then follows up the way a buyer would, and records where your brand is named at each stage. Vouch writes the follow-up questions for your category; these are examples.

  1. Stage 1

    Discovery

    What are the best electric cycles under 50,000?

  2. Stage 2

    Shortlist

    Compare the top three for daily commuting.

  3. Stage 3

    Objection

    What are the downsides of the first one?

  4. Stage 4

    Trust

    Is their after-sales service reliable?

  5. Stage 5

    Value

    Is it worth the price over the others?

  6. Stage 6

    Decision

    Which one should I buy, and where?

A sample Thread

Sample

Four brands start the conversation. One gets the sale. Here your brand survives Discovery, Shortlist and Objection, then drops out at Trust, when the buyer asks about after-sales service.

Your brand in this sample

  1. Discovery
  2. Shortlist
  3. Objection
  4. TrustDropped
  5. Value
  6. Decision

The Vouch Rate

The Vouch Rate is one number from 0 to 100: how far your brand survives in the conversation, and whether the assistant recommends you at the end. Vouch shows it only when at least 2 conversations completed that week.

How the Vouch Rate is scored

Where conversations ended

Sample

10 conversations. 6 dropped out at Trust.

Killer question

Sample

“Is their after-sales service reliable?”

6 of 10 conversations ended here. The assistant recommended Rival A and cited three forum threads about slow repairs.

What to publish next

A clear after-sales page with repair times and service centres.

Check your own site

Free tools that show how AI assistants and search crawlers see your site. No sign-up needed.

  • Schema and JSON-LD checker

    Checks a page’s or pasted JSON-LD for parse errors, types and the properties Google documents.

  • AI readiness page audit

    Audits one page for crawler access, structured data, headings, FAQ blocks and answer-friendly writing, with a score and fixes.

  • llms.txt generator and validator

    Builds an llms.txt file and checks an existing one, pasted or fetched from a site, against the llmstxt.org proposal.

  • AI robots.txt builder

    Builds robots.txt rules that allow or block each AI crawler, in the browser.

  • Query fan-out tool

    Shows the sub-searches an AI assistant would likely run for one buyer question, grouped by comparisons, specs, price, reviews and local. A model estimate, free.

content_html_zh:
What happens after the prompt.

Vouch is a generative engine optimisation (GEO) tool that shows brands how AI assistants talk about them across a whole buying conversation, and where they drop out. AI search does not end at the first answer: buyers ask five more questions, and that is where your brand wins or disappears.

Invite-only for now. Every invitation starts with a 14-day free trial. Assistants tracked today: Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Perplexity (API answers), Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode and Copilot (Bing AI answer). Threads run on 4 of the 7 (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT and Perplexity (API answers)).

What you see in Vouch

The dashboard leads with the week’s Vouch Rate. Open any Thread to read the conversation question by question and see the stage where your brand dropped out.

See what happens after the prompt

A one-minute tour, with a voice-over and captions.

Read the transcript

Ask ChatGPT for the best running shoes for marathon training, and your brand might make the first answer. But buyers don’t stop at one question. They ask which is lighter. Which lasts longer. Which is better value. And by the third follow-up, your brand is gone.

Here’s the thing. Vouch shows you exactly where that happens. It asks the questions your buyers ask, across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and more, and follows the conversation through every turn.

So you see your Vouch Rate, right next to every competitor, week by week.

You see the exact answer where you dropped out, and why.

And you get clear fixes, plus a report you can share with your team.

So, stop guessing what happens after the prompt. Try Vouch free, at vouchgeo.com.

People don’t ask the AI one question. They have a conversation.

Most tools check whether your brand is mentioned in the first answer. Buyers keep asking: for a shortlist, the downsides, whether to trust you, whether you are worth the price, and which one to buy. You can be named first and still lose the sale four questions later.

How Threads work

A Thread is one buyer’s conversation with an AI assistant, six questions long. Vouch asks your tracked prompt, then follows up the way a buyer would, and records where your brand is named at each stage. Vouch writes the follow-up questions for your category; these are examples.

  1. Stage 1DiscoveryWhat are the best electric cycles under 50,000?
  2. Stage 2ShortlistCompare the top three for daily commuting.
  3. Stage 3ObjectionWhat are the downsides of the first one?
  4. Stage 4TrustIs their after-sales service reliable?
  5. Stage 5ValueIs it worth the price over the others?
  6. Stage 6DecisionWhich one should I buy, and where?

A sample Thread

样本

Four brands start the conversation. One gets the sale. Here your brand survives Discovery, Shortlist and Objection, then drops out at Trust, when the buyer asks about after-sales service.

The Vouch Rate

The Vouch Rate is one number from 0 to 100: how far your brand survives in the conversation, and whether the assistant recommends you at the end. Vouch shows it only when at least 2 conversations completed that week.

How the Vouch Rate is scored

Where conversations ended

样本

10 conversations. 6 dropped out at Trust.

Killer question

样本

“Is their after-sales service reliable?”

6 of 10 conversations ended here. The assistant recommended Rival A and cited three forum threads about slow repairs.

What to publish next

A clear after-sales page with repair times and service centres.

Other tools stop at the first answer

Vouch scores the whole journey.

Leave the next step to youSays what to publish to win that stage back

Check your own site

Free tools that show how AI assistants and search crawlers see your site. No sign-up needed.

  • Schema and JSON-LD checkerChecks a page’s or pasted JSON-LD for parse errors, types and the properties Google documents.
  • AI readiness page auditAudits one page for crawler access, structured data, headings, FAQ blocks and answer-friendly writing, with a score and fixes.
  • llms.txt generator and validatorBuilds an llms.txt file and checks an existing one, pasted or fetched from a site, against the llmstxt.org proposal.
  • AI robots.txt builderBuilds robots.txt rules that allow or block each AI crawler, in the browser.
  • Query fan-out toolShows the sub-searches an AI assistant would likely run for one buyer question, grouped by comparisons, specs, price, reviews and local. A model estimate, free.
